name: Active Cell Geometry Generation
definition: A geometry shader technique that generates cube geometry for active voxels in a volume dataset. It uses a flag volume to determine activity and expands a unit cube centered at the origin to the actual voxel size and world position.
summary: Active Cell Geometry Generation is a geometry shader technique that generates cube geometry for active voxels using a flag volume, distinguishing itself by handling pre-computed active cells rather than raw triangle input.
